About this item

  • TODDLER BUSY BINDER BOOK – Designed using the Montessori method, this hands-on learning book helps toddlers develop independence, problem-solving, and cognitive skills.
  • 22 FUN & INTERACTIVE ACTIVITIES – Includes a variety of engaging activities like sticker-based matching and wipe-clean problem-solving, promoting early learning through play.
  • 100+ REUSABLE STICKERS – Enhances fine motor skills, logical thinking, and memory by encouraging children to place stickers in the correct spots and reinforce concepts.
  • WIPE & CLEAN ACTIVITIES FOR REPEAT LEARNING – Features erasable pages for tracing, problem-solving, and writing practice, allowing repeated learning without mess.
  • THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED FOR KIDS – Made with chunky board pages, rounded edges, and coated surfaces, ensuring a safe, engaging, and easy-to-use experience for toddlers.
  • SAFE, DURABLE & ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIAL – Crafted from high-quality, child-safe, and environmentally friendly recycled board, built to last through endless play.
  • PERFECT EDUCATIONAL GIFT FOR TODDLERS – A great Montessori toy for preschoolers, ideal for home learning, travel, and quiet time, making it the perfect gift for early learners.

    Product description

    Early years are critical for a child's development; therefore, fostering holistic growth is paramount. Einstein Box specializes in aiding parents by providing best-in-class learning kits to their children in these crucial years. Our mission is to spark their curiosity, promote hands-on learning, and inspire a lifelong love for science in children between ages 0 to 14 years by offering comprehensive learning kits tailored specifically to their age. These kits are meticulously crafted to offer an immersive learning journey that cultivates critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Give your child the gift of boundless curiosity and set them on the path to becoming the innovators of tomorrow. Einstein Box is an ideal gift for Birthdays, Diwali, Holi, Christmas, Thanksgiving, or any other occasion. A digital access code also grants exclusive access to online content and interactive resources, extending learning beyond the kit.

The planting activity and the stickers are very nice concept. She just turned 3 and not very good at puzzle part. So I am trying to infuse the interest. Kids of this age can not play totally independently. Parents would need to sit and explain. If you are a working parents and you think Kid will engage himself /herself and get rid of TV. Then the idea is not correct.

      Innovative box
      Reviewed in India on 18 May 2018
      Style Name: 1 Box Set
      Verified Purchase

      My baby loved the activities very much.

      Tiggy has become one of her favorite characters!She started saying "I am big girl like Tiggy. I am 3 yrs old".

      The planting activity and the stickers are very nice concept. She was inspired by the planting idea and came across new terms like 'nursery', 'roots' etc.

      The fork painting kit is a new idea and she loved it as well.

      She just turned 3 and not very good at puzzle part. So I am trying to infuse the interest. But she lost a few of the small parts :(

      Pros:

      4 ideas suitable for 3yr olds

      Focuses on basic needs and helps to build vocabulary, independence

      Reusable and engaging for a longer span

      Nice engaging activities for even parents

      Cons:

      Be it any box. Kids of this age can not play totally independently. Parents would need to sit and explain. If you are a working parents and you think Kid will engage himself /herself and get rid of TV. Then the idea is not correct.

    About this Item

    • TODDLER BUSY BINDER BOOK – Designed using the Montessori method, this hands-on learning book helps toddlers develop independence, problem-solving, and cognitive skills.
    • 22 FUN & INTERACTIVE ACTIVITIES – Includes a variety of engaging activities like sticker-based matching and wipe-clean problem-solving, promoting early learning through play.
    • 100+ REUSABLE STICKERS – Enhances fine motor skills, logical thinking, and memory by encouraging children to place stickers in the correct spots and reinforce concepts.
    • WIPE & CLEAN ACTIVITIES FOR REPEAT LEARNING – Features erasable pages for tracing, problem-solving, and writing practice, allowing repeated learning without mess.
    • THOUGHTFULLY DESIGNED FOR KIDS – Made with chunky board pages, rounded edges, and coated surfaces, ensuring a safe, engaging, and easy-to-use experience for toddlers.
    • SAFE, DURABLE & ECO-FRIENDLY MATERIAL – Crafted from high-quality, child-safe, and environmentally friendly recycled board, built to last through endless play.
    • PERFECT EDUCATIONAL GIFT FOR TODDLERS – A great Montessori toy for preschoolers, ideal for home learning, travel, and quiet time, making it the perfect gift for early learners.

    Product description

    Early years are critical for a child's development; therefore, fostering holistic growth is paramount. Einstein Box specializes in aiding parents by providing best-in-class learning kits to their children in these crucial years. Our mission is to spark their curiosity, promote hands-on learning, and inspire a lifelong love for science in children between ages 0 to 14 years by offering comprehensive learning kits tailored specifically to their age. These kits are meticulously crafted to offer an immersive learning journey that cultivates critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Give your child the gift of boundless curiosity and set them on the path to becoming the innovators of tomorrow. Einstein Box is an ideal gift for Birthdays, Diwali, Holi, Christmas, Thanksgiving, or any other occasion. A digital access code also grants exclusive access to online content and interactive resources, extending learning beyond the kit.
